codes.label: Free and Open Source Software
codes.definition: Free and Open Source Software, abiding by the four essential freedoms of free software, and the Open Source definition

codes.label: Zero Internet
codes.definition: Zero Internet required to install and run the software (excluding a potential one-off download step)

codes.label: Full Privacy
codes.definition: Full Privacy, such that the entity you got the software from never gets any personal information about you and does not spy on you

codes.label: Zero Licensing Servers
codes.definition: Zero Licensing Servers required to download, install, or run the software

codes.label: Zero Registration
codes.definition: Zero Registration required to download, install, or run the software

codes.label: Full-Featured
codes.definition: Full-Featured, without limitations (this means that it is fully usable for its intended purpose and free of timed or sporadic crippling. It does not mean that it includes all the features of a paid counterpart)

codes.label: Archivable
codes.definition: Archivable such that it can be backed up and reinstalled later without requiring new licenses/registrations, or a connection to the Internet

codes.label: Zero Cost
codes.definition: Zero Cost, meaning that no outlay of money is required to attain or run the software

codes.label: No Nagging
codes.definition: No Nag screens/boxes asking you to buy an upgrade or another product such that it interferes with regular operation of the software

codes.label: Ready To Run
codes.definition: Ready To Run, or extremely easy and low cost to compile from source code

codes.label: Low Run Cost
codes.definition: Low Run Cost, meaning that it doesn't have prohibitively expensive hardware requirements

codes.label: Low Financial Cost
codes.definition: Low Financial Cost, meaning that it isn't prohibitively expensive to purchase
